gloss: subject of a painting; title of a painting

definitions.gloss: subject of a painting; motif; pictorial theme
definitions.explanation: The subject matter or theme depicted in a painting or drawing. Can also refer to the title given to a finished artwork.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{画題|がだい}だ。
examples.english: Mount Fuji is a popular painting subject.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花鳥|かちょう}→花鳥：14018_kachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本画|にほんが}→日本画：18225_nihonga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な{画題|がだい}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Flowers and birds are a quintessential subject in Japanese painting.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{画題|がだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧」⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}いて→描く：02013_egaku⟧よい。
examples.english: The painting theme for the contest is 'My Hometown,' and participants may paint freely.

notes:
USAGE: {画題|がだい} is used in art criticism, exhibition descriptions, and discussions of painting. It can mean both the subject matter (what is depicted) and the title (the name of the work).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画題|がだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a subject for a painting
- {画題|がだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use as a painting subject
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{画題|がだい}: a popular painting subject

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {画題|がだい}: painting subject or title
- ⟦{題材|だいざい}→題材：10140_daizai⟧: subject matter (broader, not limited to painting)
- ⟦{主題|しゅだい}→主題：11545_shudai⟧: main theme (of any work of art or discourse)
